verses.autre-burdu-c8-v16: kaʾannahum fī ẓuhūri l-khayli nabtu rubā min shiddati l-ḥazmi lā min shiddati l-ḥuzumi
verses.autre-burdu-c8-v17: ṭārat qulūbu l-ʿidā min baʾasihim faraqā famā tufarriqu bayna l-bahmi wal-buhumi
verses.autre-burdu-c8-v18: waman takun birasūli llāhi nuṣratuhu ʾin talqahu l-ʾusdu fī ʾājāmihā tajimi
verses.autre-burdu-c8-v19: walan tarā min waliyyi ghayri muntaṣiri bihi walā min ʿaduwwi ghayri munqaṣimi
verses.autre-burdu-c8-v20: ʾaḥalla ʾummatahu fī ḥirzi millatihi kallaythi ḥalla maʿa l-ʾashbāli fī ʾajami
verses.autre-burdu-c8-v21: kam jaddalat kalimātu llāhi min jadili fīhi wakam khaṣṣama l-burhānu min khaṣimi
verses.autre-burdu-c8-v22: kafāka bil-ʿilmi fī l-ʾummiyyī muʿjizata fī l-jāhiliyyati wat-taʾadībi fī l-yutumi
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v1: khadamtuhu bimadīḥi ʾastaqīlu bihi dhunūba ʿumri maḍā fī sh-shiʿri wal-khidami
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v2: ʾidh qalladāniyā mā tukhshā ʿawāqibuhu kaʾannanī bihimā hadyu mina n-naʿami
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v3: ʾaṭaʿtu ghayyā ṣ-ṣibā fī l-ḥālatayni wamā ḥaṣaltu ʾillā ʿalā l-ʾāthāmi wan-nadmi
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v4: fayā khasārata nafsi fī tijāratihā lam tashtari d-dīna bid-dunyā walam tasumi
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v5: waman yabiʿ ʾājilā minhu biʿājilihi yabin lahu l-ghabnu fī bayʿi wafī salami
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v6: ʾin ʾāti dhanbā famā ʿahdī bimuntaqiḍi mina n-nabiyyī walā ḥablī bimunṣarimi
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v7: faʾinna lī dhimmaha minhu bitasmiyatī muḥammadā wahwa ʾawfā l-khalqi bidh-dhimami
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v8: ʾin lam yakun fī maʿādī ʾākhidhā biyadī faḍlā waʾillā faqul yā zallaha l-qadami
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v9: ḥāshāhu ʾan yaḥrima r-rājī makārimahu ʾaw yarjiʿa l-jāru minhu ghayra muḥtarami
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v10: wamundhu ʾalzamtu ʾafkārī madāʾiḥahu wajadtuhu likhalāṣī khayra multazimi
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v11: walan yafūta l-ghinā minhu yadā taribat ʾinna l-ḥayā yunbitu l-ʾazhāra fī l-ʾakami
verses.autre-burdu-c9-v12: walam ʾurid zahrata d-dunyā llatī qtaṭafat yadā zuhayri bimā ʾathnā ʿalā harami
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v1: yā ʾakrama l-khalqi mā lī man ʾalūdhu bihi siwāka ʿinda ḥulūli l-ḥādithi l-ʿamimi
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v2: walan yaḍīqa rusūla llāhi jāhuka bī ʾidhā l-karīmu taḥḥalā bīsmi muntaqimi
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v4: yā nafsu lā taqnaṭī min zallahi ʿaẓumat ʾinna l-kabāʾira fī l-ghufrāni kallalmami
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v5: laʿalla raḥmaha rabbī ḥīna yaqsimuhā taʾatī ʿalā ḥasabi l-ʿiṣyāni fī l-qisami
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v6: yā rabbi wājʿal rajāʾī ghayra munʿakisi ladayka wājʿal ḥisābī ghayra munkharimi
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v7: waṭ-ṭuf biʿabdika fī d-dārayni ʾinna lahu ṣabrā matā tadʿuhu l-ʾahwālu yanhazimi
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v8: waʾadhan lisuḥbi ṣalāti minka dāʾimahi ʿalā n-nabiyyī bmunhhali munsajimi
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v9: mā rannaḥat ʿadhabāti l-bāni rīḥu ṣabā waʾaṭraba l-ʿīsa ḥādī l-ʿīsi bin-naghami
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v10: thumma r-riḍā ʿan ʾabī bakri waʿan ʿumari waʿan ʿaliyyi waʿan ʿuthmāna dhī l-karami
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v11: wal-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi thumma t-tābiʿīna fahum ʾahlu t-tuqā wan-naqā wal-ḥilmi wal-karami
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v12: yā rabbi bil-muṣṭafā balligh maqāṣidanā wāghfir lanā mā maḍā yā wāsiʿa l-karami
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v13: wāghfir ʾilahī likulli l-muslimīna bimā yatlūhu fī l-masjidi l-ʾaqṣā wafī l-ḥarami
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v14: bijāhi man baytuhu fī ṭaybati ḥaramu waismuhu qasamu min ʾaʿẓami l-qasami
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v15: wahadhihi burdatu l-mukhtāri qad khutimat wal-ḥamdu llāhi fī badʾi wafī khatami
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v16: ʾabyātuhā qad ʾatat sittīna maʿ mīʾati farrij bihā kurbanā yā wāsiʿa l-karami
verses.autre-burdu-c7-v3: sarayta min ḥarami laylā ʾilā ḥarami kamā sarā l-badru fī dāji mina ẓ-ẓulami
verses.autre-burdu-c7-v4: wabitta tarqā ʾilā ʾan nilta manzilaha min qābi qawsayni lam tudrak walam turami
verses.autre-burdu-c7-v8: khafaḍta kulla maqāmi bil-ʾiḍāfati ʾidh nūdīta bir-rafʿi mithla l-mufradi l-ʿalami
verses.autre-burdu-c5-v16: biʿāriḍi jāda ʾaw khilta l-biṭāḥa bihā saybu mina l-yammi ʾaw saylu mina l-ʿarimi
verses.autre-burdu-c10-v3: faʾinna min jūdika d-dunyā waḍarratahā wamin ʿulūmika ʿilma llōḥi wal-qalami
